programme.title: Five Elements Ninjas
programme.desc: When evil ninjas brutally slaughter students from a noble Chinese kung-fu academy, the one survivor forms a powerful group to avenge his fallen comrades.

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this sequel, the Mad Monk is joined by immortal scholar-turned-genie, Lu Tung Pin, as they both wreak havoc in an attempt to outdo each other!

programme.title: The Lady Assassin
programme.desc: See how Prince 4 tries his hardest to kill the heir apparent, Prince 14 and how, out of frustration, he finally engages an assassin to do the job.

programme.desc: Controversial director Chu Yuan combines stars to create a masterpiece about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women expect of it.

programme.desc: The story of the Shaolin Temple's betrayal by the White-Browed Hermit and Shaolin hothead Fong Sai-yuk's revenge bid gets retold again.

programme.desc: Directed by Lee Han-hsiang and starring Michael Hui, this blockbuster confirms Hui's versatile talents as the king of comedy.

programme.title: The Thundering Sword
programme.desc: In this wuxia work, not everyone is happy when a student of the Grand Master falls for the Poison's Master daughter.

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: In this adapation of a Qiong Yao novel, a young woman finds lust, trouble, and, finally, happiness at a picturesque farm.

programme.title: Buddha's Palm
programme.desc: This new adaptation of the most powerful martial arts form is a cult classic for all fans. Witness breathtaking special effects.

programme.title: The Adulteress

programme.title: The Golden Buddha
programme.desc: A ruthless gang goes up against a millionaire's daughter who has one of three priceless Golden Buddha statues.

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber

programme.title: Tiger Killer

programme.title: Love With the Perfect Stranger

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: Catch this rare gem, a product of Hong Kong-style science fiction, complete with out-of-this-world visual effects.

programme.title: Temple of the Red Lotus
programme.desc: When the family that a man named Wu (Jimmy Wang Yu) marries into comes under repeated attack, he suspects that his in-laws are bandits.

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: In this twisted comedy, a gambling game between a rookie con artist and an experienced flimflam man has life or death repercussions.

programme.title: The Assassin

programme.title: The Mad Monk

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Alexander Fu Sheng stars in this movie as a man who is supposed to die from a cut by a sword with a teardrop forged onto its blade.

programme.title: The Master of Kung Fu

programme.title: The Warlord

programme.title: The Condemned

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins

programme.title: Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: An old grudge between the families of the Ching and Ming supporters in Kwang Tung, finally draws a young man back to avenge his father's death.

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Problems ensue after one of two childhood friends who have vowed to become sisters through the exchange of bracelets gets married.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxer
programme.desc: After enduring several trials (including his girlfriend's rape), a man (Chen Wo-Fu) puts his tai chi skills to deadly use.

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: This fascinating, humorous box office smash captures a cross-section of Hong Kong society and their issues -- all crammed into a single tenement building.

programme.title: Rolls, Rolls, I Love You
